dish.title: Korean Ojingeo Bokkeum: Spicy Stir-Fried Squid with Vegetables and Rice
dish.description: Scored squid pieces and tentacles stir-fried over high heat with cabbage, carrot, onion, scallions, and jalapeno in a sweet-hot sauce of gochugaru, gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, garlic, and ginger, finished with toasted sesame oil and sesame seeds and served over short-grain rice.

recipe_version.title: Korean Ojingeo Bokkeum: Spicy Stir-Fried Squid with Vegetables and Rice
recipe_version.description: Scored squid pieces and tentacles stir-fried over high heat with cabbage, carrot, onion, scallions, and jalapeno in a sweet-hot sauce of gochugaru, gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, garlic, and ginger, finished with toasted sesame oil and sesame seeds and served over short-grain rice.

ingredients.name: gochujang
ingredients.display_name: gochujang whose label lists rice, chile, soybeans, wheat, and salt

ingredients.name: cleaned squid
ingredients.preparation: bodies opened, scored, and cut into 2-inch pieces

steps.title: Rinse the rice
steps.body: Rinse the rice until the rinse runs clear.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: While you prep and stir-fry (overlap stated): combine the rice and 1 3/4 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high, about 4 minutes, then cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes. Leave it covered off the heat to rest 10 minutes.

steps.title: Prep the squid
steps.body: Pat the squid dry. Slit the bodies open, score the inside in a crosshatch, and cut into 2-inch pieces; halve large tentacle clusters.

steps.title: Sauce and vegetables
steps.body: Mince the garlic, grate the ginger, and stir them with the gochugaru, gochujang, soy sauce, and sugar in the small bowl. Slice the onion and jalapeno, cut the carrot into batons and the cabbage into squares, and cut the scallions.

steps.title: Stir-fry
steps.body: Heat the oil in the 12-inch skillet over high until shimmering, about 2 minutes. Stir-fry the onion, carrot, and cabbage until crisp-tender, about 4 minutes. Add the sauce and jalapeno for 30 seconds, then the squid and scallions, and stir-fry until the squid just turns opaque and curls, about 2 minutes. Off the heat stir in the sesame oil.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon over the rice and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
